root_order: Explicit per-epoch permutation; random or 64-node BFS chunks rotated and reshuffled; no DGL reshuffle

primary_timing: synchronized wall time around iterator creation and complete training loop; setup and post-run audits excluded; no sum of nested timers
legacy_timing_diagnostic: sample + inclusive fetch + model host spans retained explicitly as overlapping, not as E2E
fixes: drain window and merged results after upstream EOF
support sub-controller-page cache geometry and PRP offsets

features: original real float32 values; reordered physical rows for DiGiT

accumulator_bound_scope: Same bounds for both arms; one oversized batch may run alone without splitting roots
